title: International National Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain Level 4
description: Develop expertise in logistics and supply chain with a focus on optimizing operations, enhancing efficiency, and driving strategic growth in global markets.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and OTHM UK
longDescription: The Undergraduate Level 4 Diploma in logistics and supply chain is a 120 credit course designed to fast-track students to the final year of an associated Undergraduate B.A (Hons) endorsed in Business Management, which can either be completed on campus or via distance learning. The course is made up of 6 units of Level 4 modules (120 credits). The endorsed Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain (Level 4) provides a solid foundation in Academic Writing and Research Skills (20 credits), Logistics and the Business Environment (20 credits), Operations and Logistics Management (20 credits), Finance and Accounting (20 credits), Communication in Business (20 credits), and Leading and Managing Teams (20 credits). It emphasizes academic rigor, critical thinking, and effective research methods.
courseDetails: Each module consists of 40 guided learning hours of material with an additional 30-50 hours worth of optional materials which comprise of recommended exercises, recommended readings and internet resources. Within the modules are self-testing exercises. You must take care in answering these. Although they are not marked nor do they count towards your final assessment, the marking is tested against your scoring on the final assessment to check for consistency of score. Successful completion of the full Level 4 endorsed Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain will provide students with the necessary credentials to pursue careers in supply chain management, logistics coordination, operations management, procurement, or logistics consultancy.

entry: For entry into Level 4 Endorsed Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
